title: EU releases an additional €10 million in humanitarian aid for the Cuban population
content: The aid will prioritise healthcare, including procuring medicines and supporting primary and maternal healthcare facilities; emergency food assistance and nutrition treatment for children and mothers.

title: EU provides €20 million in humanitarian funding following earthquakes in Venezuela
content: Today's announcement add to the €5 million life-saving assistance already approved at the end of June, and to the €52 million allocated at the beginning of the year to respond to the humanitarian consequences of the socio-economic crisis in Venezuela.
